newsitem.title: TAIWAN: First Int'l Jan-Nov sales up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: First Int'l Jan-Nov sales up 11 pct.

text.p: First International Computer Inc, Taiwan's second largest computer firm, said on Monday its combined sales revenues between January and November rose 11 percent to T$25.129 billion from the same 1995 period.
In the month of November alone, the firm's sales totalled T$2.641 billion, down 16 percent from November 1995, a company statement said.
The statement gave no profit figures, but said it planned to raise its 1996 profit target in the near term.
The firm has set a full-year 1996 pretax profit target of T$1.21 billion on sales of T$30 billion.
